name: pump-profile-differs
description: Six hours on a pump profile that is not the app's: six segments from 0.6 to 1.1 U/hr, each at most 4 hours long, so every window crosses a segment change. The harness seeds the app with a flat 0.85 U/hr schedule, so the driver finds the pump's basal rate off the app's, writes the app's schedule over the pump's, and a setup history load finds basal the app did not count. A 2.0 U pump bolus 150 minutes ago and a 130% temp rate for 30 minutes from 70 minutes ago. About 1.0 U IOB with Control-IQ off.
